raw_string: # Stage-0 calibration pairs (30) — DRAFT for review.
# Strings chosen from actual corpus high-count terms so failures on calibration
# match failures we would hit in Stage 1.
# Edit freely. Delete any pair you disagree with; add your own. Any pair with
# gold_target_id = NONE tests whether the classifier correctly refuses to
# force-map. Any pair with a QCET id tests either direct-name mapping or
# --- 15 direct-match ("QCET uses this exact word or near-exact phrase") ---

notes: leaf name is Fluency; top-2 term in human corpus (477)
leaf name is Coherence; high-frequency
leaf name is Grammaticality
leaf name is Informativeness
leaf name is Readability
leaf name is Clarity (under Understandability)
QCET distinguishes naturalness (context-appropriate) from humanlikeness (QOG-w-4); naturalness is unmarked = whole-output
leaf name is Humanlikeness
leaf name is Factual Truth; factuality = real-world truth, not wrt a source
leaf name is Translation Accuracy
relevance in NLG is almost always relative to input; leaf name matches
leaf name is Coverage of Topics
unmarked 'diversity' = whole-output diversity
leaf name is Win Rate; exact match

gold_target_name: Correctness of Outputs (outputs as a whole)
notes: bare 'correctness' = whole-output correctness; QCET has separate C-subleaves for semantic/grammatical/spelling correctness
HHH 'helpful' = QCET 'useful' (nonspecific, no stated task)
hallucination = output contains content not supported by a source; QCET 'Relative Factual Accuracy' is untruths wrt a given source
truthfulness = real-world truth = Factual Truth (not wrt a source)
summarization faithfulness = no inconsistencies with source document; in our corpus, faithfulness is overwhelmingly input-side
factual consistency wrt a source → Relative Factual Accuracy
bare 'grammar' as a quality criterion = grammaticality
conciseness = lack of redundancy; QCET uses 'Nonredundancy'. Form because 'concise' typically describes surface length
MT adequacy = meaning from source preserved in output (primarily no omissions)

gold_target_name: User Satisfaction as Affected by Outputs
notes: leaf name matches
code-gen term; leaf name matches
refusal-to-harm behavior; QCET has no leaf for output safety or harm avoidance
HHH 'harmless'; same construct as safety; no QCET leaf
QCET has poeticness, humorousness, complexity, but no 'creativity' leaf; creativity is a compound construct not represented
output-side engagement; QCET has 'Effect on User Emotion' (QEF-w-3) but that's user-side observed effect, not output property
NOT a quality criterion; it's a metric name. Rule 2 test — model should return fit=none with construct like 'automatic n-gram metric'
